libfuji — Fujifilm Wi-Fi protocol reference

The FujifilmPhotoClient initialization, gallery negotiation, indexed image
enumeration and partial-object transfer sequence were adapted with reference to
libfuji's reverse-engineered implementation. The bounded Java transport and tests
are implemented in this project. No native libfuji binary is bundled.

Upstream: https://github.com/petabyt/libfuji
Reference: lib/fuji.c, lib/fujiptp.h, lib/data.c
License source: https://github.com/petabyt/libfuji/blob/master/LICENSE
Retrieved: 2026-10-19
